before: Header, footer, and note body members such as revisions, lists, search, and insertParagraph refused with InvalidObjectPath until an earlier sync resolved the body.
after: Those members read the body handle when the batch is planned, so the sync that resolves the body also runs them.
reason: Only the client proxy changes when it reads a handle. The host receives the same operations in the same order as with the earlier sync, and document operations, shared state, and the collaboration format stay unchanged.
